integrity: The proof is symbolic. It independently combines the focal source's exact fourth-cumulant contraction identity with the source normalization, Hilbert--Schmidt trace identities, and the eigenvalue Cauchy--Schwarz inequality. No numerical sampling or finite computation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: No sharpness or equality classification is claimed. The estimate applies to the complex Hermite sector \(\mathcal H_{2,1}\) through the real first-flattening effective rank of \(\sqrt2\,\operatorname{Re}q\), and it does not improve the dimension-free numerical bounds for the complex Grothendieck constant. An equivalent formulation may exist in the broader Wiener-chaos contraction literature.
title: Effective-rank fourth-moment gap in the complex cubic Hermite sector
